channel.title: Crypto Readout
channel.description: Crypto Readout reports on Bitcoin, Ethereum and altcoin markets, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, network upgrades and crypto regulation worldwide.

item.title: Mesh and Visa link wallet balances to 175 million merchants
item.description: Mesh and Visa will let participating wallet apps route crypto, stablecoin and fiat balances to Visa payments, avoiding a separate card while rollout details remain pending.

item.title: How to Choose a BaiBai Swap Quote
item.description: A swap quote is a route-specific estimate, not a promise: compare the tokens received after fees, then check slippage, network and execution limits.

item.title: Relay bridge routes: how to weigh speed, cost and settlement
item.description: A relay bridge quote is a choice between what arrives, how soon it arrives and what the route costs; compare the output and settlement before signing.

item.title: What Happens While a Crypto Bridge Transfer Is Pending
item.description: A bridge transfer stays pending while its source transaction, cross-chain message or destination action is processed, with timing set by the bridge design.

item.title: Ledger implant probe prompts MediaMarkt sales halt in Europe
item.description: Ledger says an implant copied recovery phrases from CryptoBilis wallets over LTE; MediaMarkt Saturn paused European sales after a customer report in Germany.

item.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutions
item.description: JPMorgan has added Ethereum support for JPM Coin, letting institutional clients move dollar deposit claims onchain across a wider EVM network for payments.

item.title: Coinbase and Marqeta connect stablecoins to card spending
item.description: Coinbase will custody and convert stablecoin balances for Marqeta card programs, while Base settles onchain and Marqeta handles card issuance and payment processing.

item.title: Ledger details CryptoBilis implant as MediaMarkt pauses sales
item.description: Ledger says an implant in CryptoBilis devices captured recovery phrases over LTE; MediaMarkt paused European sales after a German customer reported tampering.

item.title: How Crypto Moves to a Protocol’s Supported Network
item.description: Moving funds to a supported network means selecting a route, asset and destination, then checking fees, wallet support and the token you will receive before signing.

item.title: Solana’s Outbound Transaction Size Depends on Its Format
item.description: Solana’s send limit depends on transaction format: legacy and v0 stop at 1,232 bytes, while v1 reaches 4,096, with different account and wallet trade-offs.

item.title: What a bridge audit checks in contracts and validators
item.description: A bridge audit checks how contracts lock or burn assets, how validators prove events across chains, and where upgrades or failures can break that chain.

item.title: How to Use Monero to Cover a DeFi Margin Call
item.description: Monero usually cannot go straight into a DeFi lending contract. To cover a debt or add collateral, XMR must first become an asset the protocol accepts.

item.title: How to Swap Funds Into an Asset Your Wallet Supports
item.description: A wallet swap works only when the destination token and network match what the wallet can display and control; check the route, fees and final asset before signing.

item.title: Check a Bridge Route’s Liquidity Before You Send
item.description: Avoid thin bridge liquidity by checking executable depth, fees and slippage, then splitting or delaying a transfer when the route cannot absorb it.

item.title: Why bridges deduct gas on the destination chain
item.description: Destination-chain gas deductions cover the cost of completing a transfer after it reaches another network, and may reduce the quoted token amount or appear separately.

item.title: How Bridge and Swap Fees Shape a Cross-Chain Quote
item.description: A cross-chain quote combines swap costs, bridge charges and network gas across each route leg, then estimates how much should arrive after execution.

item.title: Visa Direct puts USDC prefunding into production with Inyo
item.description: Visa has moved USDC prefunding for Visa Direct into commercial production with Inyo Global, giving eligible businesses a near-real-time way to fund cross-border payouts.

item.title: How Fixed-Amount Crypto Payments Work Across Chains
item.description: Fixed-amount cross-chain payments target a stated amount on the receiving chain, but quotes, fees, token decimals and execution time determine what arrives.

item.title: How a Bridge Delivers Tokens Across Networks
item.description: A cross-chain route can deliver a token your wallet’s network does not issue by moving value between chains and settling a destination asset or representation.

item.title: Diagnose a Pending BTC-to-ETH Bridge Transfer
item.description: A pending BTC-to-ETH bridge transfer can stall at Bitcoin confirmation, bridge verification, or Ethereum delivery; identify the stage before retrying or paying again.
